keepFraming.label: Keep framing
keepFraming.description: Stacks the Consistency LoRA so the edit keeps the original framing and does not drift.

flux3.description: Stacks the FLUX.3 Consistency LoRA to keep the edit on the original frame. Early release: helps weather/light and restyle drift, can hurt hair-color and pose edits.

tools.label: Outpaint
tools.description: Extend the picture beyond its borders with a seamless continuation of the scene
tools.promptTemplate: Outpaint the image: replace the solid gray areas with a seamless continuation of the scene, keeping the existing picture unchanged. {prompt}
tools.promptHint: Optional: describe what the new area should show. Blank = extend the scene seamlessly.

tools.label: Restore
tools.description: Restore a damaged photo: removes scratches, noise and blur with a soft upscale
tools.promptTemplate: Restore the photo: remove blur, noise and compression artifacts and recover sharp, natural detail, keeping the same composition, people and colors. {prompt}
tools.promptHint: Optional extra guidance, e.g. "colorize".

tools.label: Camera angle
tools.description: Re-render the scene from a new camera angle; anything the source hides is imagined
tools.promptTemplate: <qma> {azimuth} {elevation} {distance} {prompt}
tools.promptHint: Optional extra edit instruction appended after the camera prompt.

tools.label: Outfit swap
tools.description: Put the outfit from the second image onto the person in the first
tools.promptTemplate: Replace the outfit of the person in image 1 with the outfit shown in image 2, keeping the person, pose and background unchanged. {prompt}
tools.promptHint: Optional extra guidance, e.g. "keep the original shoes".

tools.label: Unblur background
tools.description: Remove background blur (bokeh) so the whole frame is sharp
tools.promptTemplate: remove blur, sharp background
tools.promptHint: No prompt needed.

tools.label: General edit
tools.description: Recolor, replace, restyle or remove anything with a plain instruction
tools.promptTemplate: {prompt}
tools.promptHint: What to change, e.g. "make the car matte black".
